title: CMIX-native 32-event truncated-BPTT midpoint oracle with deterministic state rebuild
claim: Test whether one additional source-defined deep CMIX learning operation after each causally decoded 32-byte first half produces target-scale arithmetic archive gain. This oracle does not claim that a compact adapter preserves that gain.
non_claims: The operation is not an unchanged donor update because the donor horizon is 128 events.
NNCP full-minus-output evidence is motivation, not CMIX transfer evidence.
Diagnostic or ideal-bit gains earn no score credit.
This contract is not a prize package.
activation_dependencies: cmix_obias_source_full1g_roundtrip_b_qm0_v1 is terminal and the exclusive_full1g lease is absent
cmix_obias_memory_safe_parent_q0_v1 has a terminal qualifying receipt
the v2 implementation build is content addressed
P and K pass exact synchronization on a synthetic fixture

P.name: parent
P.semantics: Execute the qualified memory-safe parent without oracle collection, extra update, or replay.

K.name: bookkeeping_identity
K.semantics: Collect every F cache and compute the complete 32-event update into detached write-suppressed buffers. Rebuild with unchanged parameters. Commit no parameter, optimizer, gradient, or trajectory delta.
K.required_identity: Every integer probability, coder state, payload byte, persistent state hash, archive byte, and inverse byte equals P.

F.name: full_truncated_midpoint_update
F.semantics: At each midpoint, apply the frozen 32-event truncated-BPTT update to live Byte-LSTM trainable parameters and optimizer state, rebuild the recurrent trajectory, and continue ordinary parent execution.

S.name: causally_misaligned_full_update
S.semantics: Execute F with the 32 first-half native target associations rotated by exactly 16 events modulo 32 while preserving caches, target multiset, arithmetic, write set, update order, and compute shape.

first_half_collection.inputs: Cache the exact Byte-LSTM input vector supplied by the parent at each event.
first_half_collection.targets: Cache the exact native Byte-LSTM target used by ComputeOutputBptt after that byte is decoded.
first_half_collection.forward_cache: Retain all native layer activations, recurrent states, output activations, ring indices, and loss inputs required by donor backward equations.
first_half_collection.causality: All cached inputs and targets are decoder-visible before the midpoint.

midpoint_update.loss: The exact native Byte-LSTM output objective and target representation used by ComputeOutputBptt.
midpoint_update.output_backward: Run donor ComputeOutputBptt equations over only the 32 cached events.
midpoint_update.recurrent_backward: Traverse events 31 down to 0 and layers in the donor reverse order using donor BackwardPass equations.
midpoint_update.boundary: Set temporal adjoints entering after event 31 and before event 0 to exact zero; the segment-start recurrent state is a stop-gradient boundary.
midpoint_update.normalization: Preserve every donor gradient scale, clip, epsilon, decay, learning-rate, and update expression. Change only the event loop bound from 128 to 32; apply no 128/32 rescaling.
midpoint_update.write_order: Preserve donor parameter enumeration and update order: output gradient construction, reverse recurrent layer updates, then output updates.
midpoint_update.optimizer: F and S write the live donor optimizer moments and increment the corresponding live optimizer step exactly once per midpoint. K performs identical arithmetic in detached buffers and discards it.
midpoint_update.parameter_closure: All Byte-LSTM parameters and output parameters touched by the donor 128-event update are touched by the 32-event oracle update; no mixer, SSE, context-model, preprocessor, or coder parameter is added to this update.

state_rebuild.snapshot: At byte 0 of each segment, retain the Byte-LSTM recurrent hidden state, cell state, recurrent input state, ring cursor, and the empty destination cache slots for the next 32 events.
state_rebuild.after_update: Restore only the segment-start recurrent dynamic state and ring cursor. Do not restore updated parameters or optimizer state.
state_rebuild.replay_inputs: Replay the 32 cached Byte-LSTM input vectors in original order under the updated F or S parameters.
state_rebuild.committed_from_replay: Commit rebuilt hidden states, cell states, recurrent dynamic state, ring cursor, and recurrent forward-cache slots. Retain original decoded targets in the corresponding slots.
state_rebuild.already_coded_prefix: Never recode or revise first-half arithmetic decisions.
state_rebuild.persistence: The added update, optimizer state, rebuilt trajectory, and ordinary downstream parent updates remain live after byte 64. No episodic reset is performed.
state_rebuild.native_cadence: Every ordinary parent update remains at its original source call site and cadence. The oracle adds one separately identified midpoint update; it does not defer, duplicate, or relocate an ordinary call.

numeric_contract.reduction_order: event descending, donor layer descending, donor parameter enumeration
numeric_contract.non_finite_policy: abort before coder use and retain receipt

synchronization.P_K_abort: Abort on the first P/K mismatch and retain full local state around that boundary.
synchronization.encoder_decoder_requirement: All hashes capable of affecting future probabilities match at every preregistered boundary.

gates.250000: exact finite archive, exact inverse, P equals K, F finite, F repeat identity; diagnostic only
gates.1000000: F archive gain over P is at least 4080 bytes, F beats S, and all exactness predicates pass
gates.10000000: F archive gain over P is at least 40793 bytes, F beats S globally and in every preregistered third, and all exactness predicates pass

economics.authority: Only actual finite arithmetic archive bytes count. A passing 10MB oracle authorizes compact-adapter implementation; it does not award score credit.
